_readme: Reviewed corrections to the M·53 target → indicator assessment ledger.
One entry per M·36 target id. The build script (scripts/build-target-indicators.mjs)
applies them on top of the deterministic vocabulary match, so a correction is
reversible by deleting one entry and rebuilding — never by editing the generated file.
id       — the M·36 target id (stable content hash; see src/data/policy-targets.generated.ts).
families — replaces the matched measurement families (keys from scripts/target-indicator-catalogue.mjs,
or 'compliance-milestone'). Omit to keep the vocabulary match.
route    — forces the assessment route ('series' | 'dataset' | 'milestone'). Omit to derive it.
rung     — forces the flow-chart row ('outcome' | 'lever' | 'enabling'). Omit to derive it.
label    — replaces the card label. Only ever a trim of the act's own wording.
reason   — REQUIRED prose reason, tagged with the pass, e.g. '[human review 2026-08] …'.
A stale id (one that matches no relevant target) fails the build rather than being ignored.
